span.p:
The Problem:
[App] writes K1 (post counter),
then K2 (comment on post K1)
Priority Queue Flush:
K2 has higher priority → flushed
first → constaint violation!

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The Solution:
Track causal groups: {K1, K2} →
flush together in same batch
